rounds.text: Quadrant Televentures is demonstrating a significant improvement in operational efficiency, as evidenced by the expansion of its operating margin to 16% in the trailing twelve months from 12% three years ago [E17]. This 4 percentage point increase indicates that the company is successfully optimizing its core business performance despite the broader revenue trends [E17]. The market is currently pricing the stock at a price-to-book ratio of -0.01x, a valuation metric that highlights the extreme disconnect between the company's current market capitalization of ₹ 33.7 Cr and its underlying financial structure [E1, E2]. The stock's momentum is strong, as it is currently trading at 97% of its 52-week range, suggesting that market participants are increasingly recognizing the value inherent in these operational gains [E4]. Conceded: [E3], [E5], [E6], [E7], [E8], and [E18]. While the long-term sales growth has been negative, the recent margin expansion proves that the company is capable of generating greater profitability from its existing operations [E5, E6, E7, E8, E17].
